investigations.title: RLS Policy Overly Permissive Authorization
investigations.question: Do the RLS policies using auth.role() = 'authenticated' grant excessive privileges, allowing any authenticated user to perform admin operations?

investigations.title: Hardcoded Admin Credentials in Source
investigations.question: Are admin passwords committed to the repository in plaintext, enabling credential compromise?

investigations.title: SSRF in Fragrantica Edge Function
investigations.question: Does the scrape-fragrantica Edge Function allow server-side request forgery via the URL parameter?

investigations.title: Missing Login Rate Limiting
investigations.question: Is there any rate limiting or brute-force protection on the admin login endpoint?

investigations.title: Tracking PII Collection Without Consent
investigations.question: Does the tracking system collect personally identifiable information (IP, fingerprint) without user consent, and transmit it over insecure connections?

investigations.title: Stored Content Injection via Product Data
investigations.question: Can malicious content injected via product names, descriptions, or image URLs affect public visitors?

investigations.title: Unrestricted Storage Uploads
investigations.question: Are file uploads to the Supabase storage bucket properly restricted by type, size, and content?

investigations.title: WhatsApp Message Injection
investigations.question: Can user-controlled input in the WhatsApp modal inject content into the pre-filled message?
